# BrowseGate Chrome extension

Load this folder as an unpacked extension in Chrome 116 or newer: open chrome://extensions, enable Developer mode, select Load unpacked, and choose this folder.

BrowseGate stores workspaces, saved pages, notes, sessions, reading status, citations, and timer state locally. History is read locally for History and Insights. The former Article Summarizer is not available in the current interface; existing saved summary records remain in local storage and are not displayed or exported.

Clipboard access happens only after a user selects copy or paste. The focus timer uses Chrome alarms and may show a completion notification. Review citations before submission. Citation output is a formatting aid, not a source verification service.
